context_requirements: Expression of CCR5, CCR2, or CXCR2 on the assayed cell line
Presence of an autocrine or paracrine chemokine ligand (e.g., CCL2, CXCL8) driving basal receptor activity
A transcriptional output program coupled to the receptor (e.g., NF-kB, MAPK, or PI3K-dependent gene expression)
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines at 10 micromolar that is absent at lower concentrations
Changes in known chemokine receptor target genes such as CCL2 or CXCL2
